svg.title: Approximately inner automorphisms through fixed factors and distant replicas
svg.desc: Weighted matching fixes two Powers factors and retains the complement. Identical replicas admit approximately inner swaps. Correcting the state defect below two to the negative n makes the action on replica n converge to the identity in predual norm, and its removal approximates the original automorphism.

g.text: Fix two tensor factors, retaining the complement
M is AFD of type III₁ with separable predual; α is any normal automorphism.
ℛ is the fixed III₁ model
Put the remaining action on one replica
𝒜 = ⊗ⱼ (ℛⱼ, ρ), with each replica the same stationary M₄ product (§4).
The swap sₙ is a limit of finite matrix swaps (§5).
For every fixed head state η: ‖η ∘ gₙ − η‖ < 2⁻ⁿ once n is beyond that head.
Aₙ = b gₙ⁻¹ = (b sₙ b⁻¹ sₙ⁻¹) Ad((aₙ⁽ⁿ⁾)*) ∈ H(𝒜)
gₙ → id, so Aₙ → b and b ∈ H(𝒜). Here H is the u-closure of inner automorphisms.
Complete proof: AIA §§1–7. The arrows denote automorphisms, not equality of inner implementers.
Source comparison: Takesaki III, XVIII.4, Theorem 4.29(i), pp. 400, 402–403.
